newsitem.title: USA: Clinton expects budget accord with Congress.
newsitem.headline: Clinton expects budget accord with Congress.

text.p: President Clinton on Friday predicted he will be able to reach an agreement with Republican congressional leaders on a new federal budget, but did not indicate how long it would take.
"I think we're going to get this agreement," Clinton said of budget talks during a speech to the National Association of Elemetary School Principals.

Clinton made his remarks a short time after discussing current budget negotiations with Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, White House Chief of Staff Erskine Bowles, and congressional liason John Hilley.
